metadata.scenario: An individual calls to find out about the company’s COVID-19 safety protocols. Category: General Information.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking, how can I help you? Hi Margaret, my name is Patricia Wilson. I was referred by Dr. Anderson. Hello Patricia! It's nice to meet you. How can I assist you today? Well, my mother is going to have a hip replacement soon, and I need to know about your COVID-19 safety protocols. Absolutely, I can provide that information. We take COVID-19 safety very seriously here at CareFirst. That’s good to hear. What specific measures are you implementing? Our staff is required to wear masks and gloves during all visits, and we perform daily health screenings before their shifts. Okay, what about sanitization protocols? We sanitize all equipment and high-touch surfaces between client visits, plus we follow strict hand hygiene practices. That sounds thorough. Do caregivers have to get tested regularly? Yes, our caregivers are tested weekly for COVID-19, especially when working with clients who are vulnerable. Great! Does that include post-surgery care? Yes, all of our services, including post-surgery care, adhere to these protocols for safety. That’s reassuring. Can you tell me more about the post-surgery care options available? Sure! We offer Post-Surgery Recovery Care priced at $85 to $110 for 1 to 3 hours of specialized support. That sounds perfect. What does that include? It includes assistance with daily activities, medication management, and monitoring for any complications. Excellent, I think that’s exactly what we need. Would you like to schedule a consultation to discuss your mother’s specific needs? Yes, I would like that. What’s the next step? I can connect you with Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator, to develop a personalized care plan. Perfect, can I have her contact number? Sure! You can reach Lisa at +13165559203. She’s available Monday through Saturday. Thanks! I’ll give her a call. No problem. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Patricia? No, that covers everything. Thank you for your help! You’re welcome! Have a great day, and we look forward to assisting your mother. Thank you, bye! Goodbye!
